items.title: Bitwise to Close Dogecoin ETF Before Its First Anniversary
items.summary: BWOW will stop trading October 14, with cash payments to remaining shareholders expected October 22.

items.title: Anchorage Digital adds institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin
items.summary: The US federally chartered crypto bank will allow institutional clients to hold, mint, redeem and stake Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin through its custody platform.

items.title: With Fed rate hike all but assured, here's how markets might react
items.summary: Traders could look past an expected Fed hike and weigh what higher rates are signaling about the economy.

items.title: Metaplanet reverses course on executive options with 41% cut to potential shares, scraps employee warrant plan
items.summary: The changes come amid a bruising stretch for Metaplanet shares, as stock fell about 17% over two trading sessions this week.
